text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Listen up, Trainer! In my dream, I did it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Exactly! I unveiled the long-standing mystery of the Umamusume body!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ah, what a sensation it was! It gave me goosebumps!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Of course, when I awoke, I had completely forgotten its secrets.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: However! That feeling of exhilaration that ran through my entire body was unforgettable!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh… I want to experience it once again. I have to make it a reality somehow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon looks happy to have had a good dream. I'm glad she was able to rest well.
